name: erp-platform
description: Modular ERP platform: one microservice per module, sharing a single identity.

scripts.test: npm run test -w @platform/identity && npm run test -w @platform/attendance
scripts.test:pg: npm run test:pg -w @platform/identity && npm run test:pg -w @platform/attendance
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @platform/identity && npm run typecheck -w @platform/attendance && npm run typecheck -w @platform/portal-web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @platform/identity && npm run build -w @platform/attendance && npm run build -w @platform/portal-web
